chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: Buddy Banks and the Clef Club jam sessions
summary: Howard says he organized the Clef Club and attended its jam sessions, naming Buddy Banks among the musicians who show up.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And Alton Red and all his -- Buddy Banks, remember Buddy Banks?
Oh, yeah, Buddy. I saw him yesterday.
Yeah? How's he doing?
He's doing fine.
You didn't -- did you know about the -- what do they call it, is it the Clet Club, where they give these jam sessions?
I certainly do. I'm a member of it. I'm a member of it.
Did you go?
He organized it.
I know, but they had one -- what, just about a month ago?
Yeah.
Did you go?
Yep.
Why don't you tell us about that?
(Laughter)
I never think of that. You're trying to keep secrets from me.
(Inaudible) What happened at that club? I mean, a jam session?
Jam sessions, that's all.
Who are some of the people that show up?
Well, I'll start out with Buddy Banks.
Okay.
Talking about Buddy Banks.
Buddy Banks was there, who else?
And me, let me see if I can get some
more. There's a whole gang. I can't begin to tell you. Most all of the musicians in town go out there.
I wish I knew who was there, because it would be good to know. Anybody else you remember there?
If you'll stop and rest a few minutes, I'll --
Okay.
Yeah.
Pat Excuse me, just pull it back to stop it for a minute.
Just press the black button.
(Recording interrupted.)
